scripts.//build: The ONE production build of this site, and a Turbo task (POD-3053): every caller goes through `turbo run build`, so there is no second recipe dev and CI can diverge on. The stamp is written LAST of the steps that WRITE, and that order is load-bearing (POD-1986): `podium-build.json` is what every reader — assertDevWebDistMatchesVersion, the dev publisher, the bundle copy — takes to mean `dist is complete`. Written earlier, it named a dist that precompression was still writing into, and a headless bundle copied in that window shipped without its .br/.gz files. The stamp is therefore written BEFORE the budget check, which reads dist and writes nothing: a red ratchet now fails the build for everyone (the dest-rebuild exemption that `build:dist` used to grant ended with POD-3053 — raise the floor in scripts/web-bundle-budget.ts, do not route around it).
scripts.build: vite build && bun ../../scripts/archive-web-sourcemaps.ts dist && bun ../../scripts/precompress-dist.ts dist && bun --conditions=@podium/source ../../scripts/write-web-build-stamp.ts dist && bun ../../scripts/web-bundle-budget.ts dist --check
scripts.//build:dev: Same artefact layout as `build`, but unminified, with linked source maps and React's DEVELOPMENT build — so a crash on a locally-served bundle reports the real error sentence and real component names instead of `Minified React error #185` (POD-1954). Slower and much larger; never what you hand to someone else.
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && bun ../../scripts/archive-web-sourcemaps.ts dist && bun ../../scripts/precompress-dist.ts dist && bun --conditions=@podium/source ../../scripts/write-web-build-stamp.ts dist
scripts.test: bun ../../scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label @podium/web:test -- bun --bun vitest --config vitest.config.ts run
scripts.test:unit: bun ../../scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label @podium/web:test:unit -- bun --bun vitest --config vitest.config.ts run
scripts.test:perf:large-state: bun ../../scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label @podium/web:test:perf -- bun --bun vitest --config vitest.frontend-perf.config.ts run
